question: Can you list the six exoplanets discovered in 2023 that helped us surpass 5,500 discoveries altogether? Please list their names and distances from Earth, in order of shortest to longest.
gold_answer: TOI-198 b: 77 light years, TOI-2095 b: 137 light years, TOI-2095 c: 137 light years, TOI-4860 b: 261 light years, MWC 758 c: 520 light years, HD 36384 b: 683 light years
